about: Fake model latencies near the real ones (journal of the owner's play-test: a deliberation's think plus compile about 10 s, a talk turn 1-2 s), so that conversation timing (LIVING_PARK) can be tried with --fake. Talk replies leave the exchange open (no end, nothing settled), so stamina and the 90 s quiet end it, as with real models; the fake's default reply settles every exchange at its first turn. Other replies are the fake server's defaults.
